name: Vegetable crates
description: Three shallow slatted crates of produce standing on the ground: green cabbages on straw and a heap of red and yellow apples side by side at the back, carrots with green tops in front; a stray cabbage and two apples lie on the ground.

provenance.prompt: Three shallow crates of cabbages, carrots and apples, about 1.2 × 0.8 × 0.5 m.
